_comment: Merged ticker reference for Serenity Tracker (price resolution + editorial). Keyed by the symbol Serenity uses. Price side: price_symbol (Yahoo-style; EODHD provider translates suffix) /exchange/currency/verified/note — only listed where it differs from the US default. Editorial side: company/industry/thesis_summary — folded into each per-stock JSON by build_db so render is self-contained. Anything not listed defaults to US (NASDAQ/NYSE, USD). build_db reads this file; meta.json is retired.

_aliases._comment: variant cashtag -> canonical primary symbol. Applied in build_db BEFORE aggregation so the same company is one row. Counting merges; price still uses the canonical listing's currency.
